notes: Motion DNA tokens. v0.2 calibrated against 6 real transitions sampled in AE (research/calibration_fit.json): entrances 12-17f, typical overshoot ~5%, exits with anticipation. v0.3: Coast, Nudge, Wind-up and Snap added from the Motion Style Map (20 analyzed references, research/styles).

durations.name: Sweep
durations.use: Changes covering half the screen or more

easings.name: Launch
easings.use: Exits that chain into another element's entrance

easings.name: Settle
easings.use: General motion and exits that don't chain

easings.name: Pop
easings.use: Entrances with overshoot/bounce for dynamic pieces

ae.note: 3 keys: 0 → 105% → 100% (Land up to the peak at 60%, Settle back)

easings.name: Recoil
easings.use: Exits with anticipation: pulls back slightly, then leaves (dynamic pieces)

ae.note: Undershoot: 3 keys (100% → -4% of the travel → target) or an expression; does not fit in 2 AE keys

easings.name: Ramp
easings.use: Speed ramp: very slow start, a burst of speed, very slow landing (transitions, reveals, footage ramps)

easings.name: Surge
easings.use: Softer speed ramp: slow, fast, slow without the extreme hold (premium moves, headlines)

easings.name: Whip
easings.use: Holds back, fires, then a long soft brake (whip pans, swipes, camera moves)

easings.name: Coast
easings.use: Clean entrances that start fast and coast to a stop (product UI, editorial type, icons)
easings.source: Motion Style Map: measured on ref08 title rise, ref05 iris open, ref15 icon hero shrink (distance 0.03-0.06)

easings.name: Nudge
easings.use: Soft arrival with a small 3% overshoot and a long settle (charts, emblems, premium UI)
easings.source: Motion Style Map: ref03 bar grow, ref19 emblem slide (distance 0.02)

easings.name: Wind-up
easings.use: Entrances with anticipation: pulls back 4%, then a long ease-out (logo slides, reveals)

ae.note: 3 keys: 0 -> -4% of the travel (Settle, 20% of the time) -> target (Coast)

easings.source: Motion Style Map: ref01 logo slide, ref03 iris reveal (distance 0.04); entrance counterpart of Recoil

easings.name: Snap
easings.use: Editorial cut-on-the-action: jumps 92% of the change in one frame, then settles the rest (scale changes, layout swaps)

ae.note: hold key: v0 -> (1 frame) 92% of the change -> target with Coast over the rest of the duration

easings.source: Motion Style Map: ref02 OpenAI (measured 4x: 80-97% in one frame, 8-10 f settle)

fonts.note: PostScript names; the first installed one wins. Font files in assets/fonts (OFL).
